requirements.name: 3GPP AVC HD Operation Point / Bitstream Requirements

cases.what: The rules require profile_idc 100, constraint_set4_flag 1 and level_idc 40.

cases.case: no more than 16 slices per picture
cases.what: The XSD requires MaxPictureSliceCount to exist and be <= 16, but the assert is multi-line (a violation is listed in errors, never made a failure), the variable is emitted only with --include-internal-vars (without it the assert is false for every stream), and it is counted per frame_num value over NAL types 1 and 5, not per picture, so pictures sharing a frame_num merge.

The two log2_max_mv_length assertions (<=11, <=9) are marked provision=recommendation and guarded by the VUI bitstream_restriction_flag, but they are multi-line with outer whitespace, so a violation never reaches warning_assertions and only appears as a generic error; actual motion vector values are not checked.
No rule checks the VCL bit rate or the cpbBrVclFactor and cpbBrNalFactor values.

cases.case: HD format colour, chroma format, SAR, chroma location, range, bit depth, frame rate
cases.what: The AVC operation point has no rule for any parameter of the 3GPP HD representation format (colour values, 4:2:0, sample aspect ratio, chroma location, range, bit depth, frame rate, resolution).
Decoding is not tested; the rules check the profile and level that define the capability (Progressive High, level 4.0).

cases.case: A 3GPP-AVC-HD Bitstream shall conform to the following requirements
cases.what: Umbrella. High Progressive (profile_idc=100, constraint_set4_flag=1), level_idc=40 and the slice limit are asserted; not covered: the 120 Mbps VCL rate with cpbBrVclFactor/NalFactor (_vcl_bit_rate is parsed but no rule), the HD format checks (see HD cases), and decodability.

noted: Level is tested for equality with 40. The H.264 text was not read, so the exact meaning of constraint_set4_flag for Progressive High is not confirmed here.

requirements.name: 3GPP HEVC Stereo / Bitstream Requirements

cases.what: Stereo loads progressive flags (frame-packing form), chroma_format_idc 1 and video_full_range_flag 0 (working single-line asserts), but the colour and chroma-location alternatives are one multi-line assert with outer whitespace, so a violation is listed in errors and never fails the run.

cases.case: stereoscopic format picture and sample aspect ratio, resolution, bit depth, frame rate

cases.case: Main 10, Main Tier, Level 5.2 with VUI and frame-packing constraints

Decoding is not tested. The code checks Main 10, Main Tier, level_idc 156 and the frame-packing and VUI rules, but the FPA parameter constraints (part of the capability) and the colour rule do not fail the run, and 'HEVC-Stereo-Dec' is not defined anywhere (5.3.2 and Table 6.1-1 give HEVC-Frame-Packed-Stereo-Dec, Level 6.0).
cases.conflict: Clause 6.3.5.2: "the Bitstream shall be decodable by a decoder with HEVC-Stereo-Dec decoding capabilities as defined in clause 5.3.2" versus clause 5.3.2, which defines no HEVC-Stereo-Dec and gives HEVC-Frame-Packed-Stereo-Dec at Main 10, Main Tier, Level 6.0, while clause 6.3.5.2 asks for Level 5.2.

requirements.name: 3GPP MV-HEVC Stereo / 3GPP MV-HEVC-Main Stereo

cases.what: The operation point loads the MV-HEVC stereo rules (VPS layer sets, scalability, default output layer, chroma 4:2:0, 3D reference displays SEI), VUI, progressive and stereo-colour rules, but 6.3.6.2 is only partly met: aspect_ratio_idc must exist (spec: if present), no check of exactly two output layers in the second OLS, progressive flags only on the nuh_layer_id=0 SPS, ScalabilityId needs --include-internal-vars, and the colour assert never fails the run (multi-line with outer whitespace).

The Main rule set requires a layer-0 SPS of Main or Main 10 and a second-layer profile_tier_level of Multiview Main only (profile 6); the other second-layer profiles clause 5.3.3 lists (Main, Main 10) are rejected; it requires at least one non-base layer, not exactly two layers, and level 5.1 Main Tier for both.

noted: Not checked: exactly two output layers in the second OLS, progressive flags of the second layer, bit depth, frame rate. Clause 6.3.6.2 is not labelled in the corpus text (it is run into 6.3.6.1).
The file itself carries a TODO for the exactly-one-enhancement-layer check. The H.265 profile numbers were not read, so the profile_idc values are taken as the rules give them.

requirements.name: 3GPP MV-HEVC Stereo / 3GPP MV-HEVC-Ext Stereo

cases.what: The operation point loads the MV-HEVC stereo rules (VPS layer sets, scalability, default output layer, chroma 4:2:0, 3D reference displays SEI), VUI, progressive and stereo-colour rules, but 6.3.6.2 is only partly met: aspect_ratio_idc must exist (spec: if present), no check of exactly two output layers in the second OLS, progressive flags only on the nuh_layer_id=0 SPS, ScalabilityId needs --include-internal-vars, and the colour assert never fails the run (multi-line with outer whitespace).

The Ext rule set requires a Main or Main 10 base layer with a second layer of Multiview Extended (profile_idc 12 or 13) only; clause 5.3.3 says the Ext capability also covers every Main-dual combination, and these are rejected; it requires at least one non-base layer, not exactly two, and level 5.1 Main Tier for both.

noted: Not checked: exactly two output layers in the second OLS, progressive flags of the second layer, bit depth, frame rate.
The file carries a TODO for the exactly-one-enhancement-layer check. The H.265 text was not read, so the profile_idc values 12 and 13 are taken as the rules give them.
